E2-2019-T2-P1-S2.trunk: 让步复句：Even as we count on forests..., we are threatening their ability...（尽管我们依赖森林……，却在威胁其能力）
structure: 让步/同时状语从句(Even as)：we humans count on forests
└ 目的不定式：to soak up a good share of the carbon dioxide
└ 定语从句〔省略 that，修饰 carbon dioxide〕：we produce
主句：we are threatening their ability
└ 不定式作后置定语：to do so
E2-2019-T2-P1-S2.logic: Even as 把“依赖森林吸碳”和“削弱其吸碳能力”并置，形成鲜明反差；do so 指代 soak up carbon dioxide。
notes: do so 用来避免重复前面的动作。

E2-2019-T2-P1-S16.trunk: 并列因果复句：That is only a small share..., so it will be vital to prioritize...（那只占一小部分，因此优先处理……至关重要）
structure: 分句①：That is only a small share of the total acreage
└ 同位补充：about half a million acres in all
结果分句(so)：it will be vital
└ 真正主语不定式：to prioritize areas
└ 介词短语作后置定语：at greatest risk of fire or drought
E2-2019-T2-P1-S16.logic: 前半句用规模对比说明资源有限，so 引出政策优先级；it 是形式主语，真正主语是后面的不定式。
notes: prioritize areas at greatest risk：优先处理风险最大的地区。

E2-2019-T2-P1-S17.trunk: S+V+O从句：The strategy aims to ensure that carbon is locked away or burned（该策略旨在确保碳被封存或燃烧利用）
structure: └ 宾语从句(that)：carbon ... is locked away ... or burned as biofuel
├ 过去分词短语〔修饰 material〕：removed from the forests
└ 定语从句(that，修饰 vehicles)：that would otherwise run on fossil fuels
E2-2019-T2-P1-S17.logic: ensure 后的 that 从句由两个并列被动谓语构成，说明木材中的碳有两种去向；otherwise 突出以生物燃料替代化石燃料。
notes: would otherwise do：否则本来会做……。
